Task: Restore whitespace splitting for scalar string values decoded into `[]string` configuration fields, including YAML and ENV.

diff --git a/internal/config/config.go b/internal/config/config.go
index 1333704..b91a2ab 100644
--- a/internal/config/config.go
+++ b/internal/config/config.go
@@ -14,13 +14,28 @@ import (
 
 var decodeHooks = mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(
 	mapstructure.StringToTimeDurationHookFunc(),
-	mapstructure.StringToSliceHookFunc(","),
+	stringToSliceHookFunc(),
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToLogEncoding),
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToCacheBackend),
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToScheme),
 	stringToEnumHookFunc(stringToDatabaseProtocol),
 )
 
+// stringToSliceHookFunc splits scalar strings on whitespace when decoding []string fields.
+func stringToSliceHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFuncType {
+	return func(from, to reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from.Kind() != reflect.String || to != reflect.TypeOf([]string{}) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		fields := strings.Fields(reflect.ValueOf(data).String())
+		if len(fields) == 0 {
+			return []string{}, nil
+		}
+		return fields, nil
+	}
+}

 	v := viper.New()
 	v.SetEnvPrefix("FLIPT")
 	v.SetEnvKeyReplacer(strings.NewReplacer(".", "_"))
+	v.AllowEmptyEnv(true)
 	v.AutomaticEnv()
 
 	v.SetConfigFile(path)

+func TestAllowedOriginsStringSources(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name  string
+		value string
+		want  []string
+	}{
+		{"multiple spaces", "foo.com bar.com  baz.com", []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"}},
+		{"mixed whitespace", " \tfoo.com\nbar.com\t\tbaz.com \n", []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"}},
+		{"empty", "", []string{}},
+		{"whitespace only", " \t\n ", []string{}},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := t.TempDir() + "/config.yml"
+			contents := fmt.Sprintf("cors:\n  allowed_origins: %q\n", tt.value)
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(contents), 0600))
+
+			cfg, err := Load(path)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+
+			t.Setenv("FLIPT_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS", tt.value)
+			cfg, err = Load("./testdata/default.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAllowedOriginsSequence(t *testing.T) {
+	path := t.TempDir() + "/config.yml"
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("cors:\n  allowed_origins:\n    - foo.com bar.com\n    - baz.com\n"), 0600))
+
+	cfg, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"}, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+}
+
+func TestStringToSliceHookSourceTypes(t *testing.T) {
+	hook := stringToSliceHookFunc()
+	target := reflect.TypeOf([]string{})
+	for _, input := range []any{[]string{"foo bar", "baz"}, []any{"foo bar", "baz"}, 42} {
+		output, err := hook(reflect.TypeOf(input), target, input)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, input, output)
+	}
+
+	input := "foo bar"
+	output, err := hook(reflect.TypeOf(input), reflect.TypeOf([]int{}), input)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, input, output)
+}
+
